proposals.evidence: Turner13139 gives Marathi/Gujarati sāt and Konkani sāta through MIA satta. Katkari sat and Saurashtra sə̄tu fit the regional sat- family; the reported central long vowel and final u are retained, as in the survey’s other u-final numerals. Printed source image and ingestion audit checked. Existing transcription uncertainty and chapter-based Katkari mapping are preserved.
